title: Angular velocity calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates ω = v₀/R = 5 rad/s.

title: Centripetal acceleration calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates a = v₀²/R = 25 m/s².

title: Time in semicircular section
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly calculates t₁ = πR/v₀ = 0.628 s for motion along APB.

title: Time in straight section
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly calculates t₂ = L/v₀ = 0.3 s for motion along BC.

title: Total time A to C
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly sums t = t₁ + t₂ = 0.928 s.

title: Projectile motion time
description: Important Criteria: Student uses x = v₀t₃ to find projectile flight time t₃ = x/v₀.

title: Table height calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates h = ½gt₃² = gx²/(2v₀²) = 0.8 m.

title: Sign or unit errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student makes sign errors in acceleration direction or omits units (rad/s, m/s², s, m).

title: Constant velocity assumption
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly assumes velocity changes on semicircular track or straight section.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Student shows unit analysis for all derived formulas.
